functions, review this event to see if it provides the information you need.
5447(S): A Windows Filtering Platform filter has been changed.
Event Description:
This event generates every time a Windows Filtering Platform filter has been changed.
It typically generates during Group Policy update procedures.
Note   For recommendations, see Security Monitoring Recommendations for this event.
